draft_text: The reported 142 versus 119 requests per second provide tentative evidence that Nimbrake might possibly achieve higher throughput than Caskline on Driftbay-Serve.
revised_text: Nimbrake was measured at 142 requests per second and Caskline at 119 requests per second on Driftbay-Serve, though the figures are not directly comparable because Nimbrake used batch size 32 and Caskline used batch size 16.
rationale: Numbers 142 and 119 match T1. However, the table note states the figures are not directly comparable (different batch sizes), so even "tentative evidence" of higher throughput is unsupported. No statistical test was reported. The claim should be narrowed to reporting the raw values and the non-comparability.
